claim: C. elegans adults exposed to Pseudomonas aeruginosa (strain PA14) learn to avoid this specific pathogen upon subsequent exposure.

claim: Murphy and colleagues reported that C. elegans adults trained to avoid PA14 transmit this learned avoidance to four generations of progeny (F1-F4).
